raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions contains 144 txn_ids delivered twice, and the copies are identical in every column, so the duplicates are exact re-deliveries. silver_transactions carries them through, which inflates every gold table. Deduplicating by txn_id in silver is safe and fixes all downstream tables.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.93, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) ORDER BY ingest_ts, batch_id) AS rn FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') WHERE rn = 1;"}}
